end.parentNote: Atharv practised noticing beaks, feet and leaf shapes, then linking webbed feet with pushing water and separate toes with walking on land. They first named a wall’s colour instead of a bird feature, then corrected this to beak shape later in the lesson. At home, show pictures of birds and ask, “What do you notice?” followed by “Why might this help the bird?”
